name: Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque
scope: Standing Atik Mustafa Pasha Mosque, Hz. Cabir Camii in Ayvansaray, with its low windowless dome, three east apses, western timber entrance porch and single stone minaret.

originalReview.notes: Interior view establishes the unquestionable windowless shallow dome, its place above the crossing of four vaulted arms and the upper and lower window forms. Decorative paint and the interior are outside the modeled exterior.

review.method: Exact published Qualla CC0 original and architectural survey facts.
review.notes: The exact covered-space photograph was already published on Qualla. It documents the restored central dome and windows. The present exterior footprint and published architectural facts control the roof, porch and minaret.
